language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language this workspace is shown in. It applies to this browser.
language.label: Interface language

general.title: General
general.description: Who you are, and the model the research agent thinks with.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The name and website of the company using this CRM.
workspace.nameDescription: Shown wherever the CRM refers to your own company.
workspace.onlyOwnerAdmin: Only an owner or an admin can change this.

researchKey.title: Company research
researchKey.description: Enter your Context API key so our agents can research every company in the CRM.
researchKey.noKeyPrompt: Don't have a Context API key?

archiveRetention.title: Archived records
archiveRetention.description: Deleted records are archived and hidden, then pruned for good.

agentModel.title: Research agent
agentModel.description: The model the agent thinks with, routed through the Vercel AI Gateway.
agentModel.modelSaved: The agent will use this model from its next session.
agentModel.unavailable: Could not reach the AI Gateway to list models. The agent is still running {model}.

copyValue.copyFailed: Could not copy {label}. Select it instead.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: What your numbers are reported in, and how the other currencies get there.

reporting.title: Reporting currency
reporting.description: Every total, chart and average in the CRM is expressed in this currency. Each deal keeps the currency it was sold in.
reporting.label: Report totals in
reporting.descriptionCanManage: Changing this re-converts every deal at today's rates. Figures already reported will move.
reporting.descriptionReadonly: Only an owner or an admin can change how money is reported.
reporting.saved: Every total is now reported in {currency}.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: How many {currency} one unit of each currency buys. Fetched daily from open.er-api.com; a rate you enter here wins.
rates.invalidRate: A rate has to be a number greater than zero.
rates.empty: No rates yet. Refresh to fetch them, or enter one by hand.

inUse.title: Currencies in use
inUse.allConvertible: Every deal with an amount can be converted into the reporting currency.
inUse.unconverted: {count, plural, one {# deal cannot be converted, so it is left out of every total.} other {# deals cannot be converted, so they are left out of every total.}}
inUse.empty: No deals have an amount yet.

members.title: Members
members.description: Everyone who has access to your CRM.

apiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: Anything using it stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.

create.description: Acts as you. Anything it can read or change is exactly what you can.
create.nameDescription: Something you will recognise later, like where it runs.

created.title: {name} created
created.description: Copy it now. Nobody, including us, can show it to you again.

sso.removeConfirmDescription: Nobody can sign in through it again. If this is the only provider, the sign-in page goes back to Google.
sso.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, domain or issuer…
sso.empty: No identity provider yet — everyone signs in with Google.

add.title: Add an identity provider
add.nameDescription: Names the sign-in button. Cannot be changed later.
add.redirectDescription: Add this at your provider before saving.

page.title: Tracking & Analytics
page.description: Track website visitors and automatically add contacts when a form is submitted.

domains.title: Allowed domains
domains.description: The script records page views on these hosts only.
domains.empty: Add the domain your website runs on to get your tracking script.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: How a returning visitor is recognised.
cookies.subdomainsHint: Set the cookie on the exact host that served the page, never on the parent domain
cookies.secureHint: Send the cookie over HTTPS and drop it on plain HTTP
cookies.dntHint: Record nothing at all when the browser asks not to be tracked
cookies.lifetimeDescription: After this a returning visitor counts as somebody new. Shorten it if your policy asks you to.

rules.title: Tracking rules
rules.description: Where the script may run, and how it follows a visitor.
rules.crossDomainHint: Carry the visitor between the domains below, so one journey is not counted as two people
rules.limitToDomainsLabel: Limit tracking to the domains below
rules.limitToDomainsHint: On any other domain the script loads and then does nothing

script.paused: Tracking paused. The script stops recording within five minutes.
script.rotated: Site ID rotated. Paste the new tag on your website.
script.copyFailed: Could not copy the script. Select it instead.
script.title: Tracking script
script.description: One tag, 4 KB, in the head of every page you measure.
script.rotateHint: Rotating it stops every copy of the old script at once.
script.gtmTab: Add it through Google Tag Manager
script.gtmStep1: In Tag Manager, add a new Custom HTML tag.
script.gtmStep2: Paste this snippet — not the one above — as the tag's HTML.
script.gtmStep3: Trigger it on All Pages, then publish the container. Keep {scriptUrl} off any consent-blocked category you do not need.
script.gtmNote: Tag Manager drops a data-site attribute when it injects a script, so this form carries the site ID in the URL instead.
script.pauseHint: The script keeps loading and records nothing. Your domains and settings are kept
script.rotateConfirmDescription: Every copy of the old script stops recording at once, including any you have forgotten about. You will need to paste the new tag on every page that carries the old one. Nothing already collected is lost.

trafficSources.title: Traffic sources
trafficSources.description: Where your visitors come from. Only people who have submitted a form are attributed to a record.
trafficSources.empty: No sources yet. They appear once the script records its first page view.

verify.title: Verify installation
verify.description: We load one page and look for the script, then read your Tag Manager container if it is not in the HTML.
verify.pageDescription: The page has to be public. A page behind a login always fails this check.
verify.unreachableDescriptionSuffix: We only follow public pages, and we never follow a redirect to a private address.
verify.missingDescription: The page answered in {ms} ms, but the tag was not in the HTML. Check that it sits in the head, above anything that rewrites the page.
verify.missingContainers: We also read Tag Manager container {containers}, and the tag is not in there either.
verify.dropTitle: Tag Manager will drop the site ID
verify.dropDescription: Container {id} carries the tag, but the site ID is not in the script URL. Tag Manager keeps only the URL when it injects a script, so a data-site attribute never reaches the page and the tracker never starts. Copy the Tag Manager snippet above and replace the tag's HTML.
verify.recentPageView: A page view did arrive in the last five minutes, so something on this site is still recording.
verify.foundDescription: It answered in {ms} ms. Site ID {siteId} matched, and this domain {allowed, select, yes {is on the allow list} other {is not on the allow list}}.
verify.foundContainerNote: The tag is not in the HTML, so it only runs once Tag Manager fires it — a page view is the proof.
verify.pageViewArrived: A page view arrived in the last five minutes.
verify.pageViewNone: No page view has arrived yet — open the page in a browser to send one.

page.title: Connections
page.description: Google is used to sign in to {appName}. Email, calendar and Slack integrations are not available in this version yet.

add.title: Add a connection
add.description: Nothing moves until you finish setting one up.
add.googleDescription: Bring in Gmail messages and Google Calendar meetings
add.slackDescription: Let deployed agents notify approved channels and people
add.microsoftDescription: Bring in Outlook email and the people on it
add.intakeDescription: The intake API is not available yet
add.connectedSummary: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is connected yet.} one {{list} is already connected.} other {{list} are already connected.}}

google.sourceCalendarAutoCreate: Add the company and contact when you meet someone new
google.sourceGmailAutoCreate: Add the company and contact when you reply to someone new
google.envHint: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in the root .env file and restart.
google.emailMismatch: That Google account has a different email address to the one you sign in with, so it cannot be attached to your account. Connect the Google account that matches your sign-in address.
google.connectDescription: Read-only Gmail and Calendar. Only conversations with companies in the CRM are stored.
google.connectFailedGeneric: Google returned an error before the connection was made. Try again.
google.mainDescription: Meetings and email threads land on the matching company as they happen.
google.noRefreshTokenTitle: Google did not return a refresh token
google.deleteConfirmDescription: Every email and meeting brought in from Google is removed from the CRM. The next check starts from now, so nothing deleted here comes back.
google.revokeRequired: You will be signed out, and you cannot use the CRM again until you grant access.
google.revokeOptional: New email and meetings stop arriving. Everything already synced stays, and you can connect Google again from this page.

microsoft.autoCreate: Add the company and contact when you reply to someone new
microsoft.envHint: Set MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET in the root .env file and restart.
microsoft.emailMismatch: That Microsoft account has a different email address to the one you sign in with, so it cannot be attached to your account. Connect the Microsoft account that matches your sign-in address.
microsoft.connectDescription: Read-only Outlook mail. Only conversations with companies in the CRM are stored.
microsoft.connectFailedGeneric: Microsoft returned an error before the connection was made. Try again.
microsoft.mainDescription: Email threads land on the matching company as they happen.
microsoft.noRefreshTokenTitle: Microsoft did not return a refresh token
microsoft.deleteConfirmDescription: Every email brought in from Outlook is removed from the CRM. The next check starts from now, so nothing deleted here comes back.
microsoft.disconnectRequired: You will be signed out, and you cannot use the CRM again until you grant access.
microsoft.disconnectOptional: New email stops arriving. Everything already synced stays, and you can connect Microsoft again from this page.
microsoft.disconnectSuffix: Microsoft has no way for us to withdraw the consent itself — remove this app from your Microsoft account to do that.

intake.title: Intake endpoint
intake.description: This connection is not available yet. No endpoint, API key, or intake activity has been created for this workspace.

never.automation: Send anything at all until you build an automation and switch it on
never.destination: Post anywhere except the destination approved in that automation
never.dm: Read a direct message between two people

create.name: When a deal is created
create.description: Post the deal to an approved sales channel.

won.name: When a deal is won
won.description: Tell an approved channel that the deal closed.

reopen.name: When a deal reopens
reopen.description: Notify one approved channel or teammate.

slack.introDescription: Connecting Slack gives the CRM a way in and a way out. What it actually does with that is up to you afterwards, one automation at a time.
slack.approveHint: You approve the workspace in Slack. You can disconnect it here at any time.
slack.suggestionsTitle: Afterwards, most teams start with one of these
slack.suggestionsHint: Suggestions, not settings. None of them exist until you pick one and switch it on.
slack.summaryCanManage: Here is what Slack gave us. Agents only post where their automation says.
slack.summaryReadonly: Here is what Slack gave us. Only an owner or an admin can disconnect it.
slack.agentsHint: Built in chat, not here. Open one to change it.
slack.noAgents: No deployed agents use Slack yet.
slack.peopleNone: No workspace people have been reviewed yet.
slack.heldBackPermissions: Slack held back {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
slack.reconnectHint: Reconnect to ask again. You lose nothing.

connectErrors.accessDenied: Slack installation was cancelled before access was granted.
connectErrors.alreadyLinked: That Slack installer is already linked to another CRM account.
connectErrors.emailMismatch: The Slack installer's email must match the CRM account you are signed in with.
connectErrors.oauthFailed: Slack rejected the app credentials or redirect URL. Check the client ID, client secret, and OAuth redirect URL, then try again.
connectErrors.userInfoMissing: Slack did not return the installer's profile. Confirm the app has users:read and users:read.email, reinstall it, then try again.

slack.disconnectConfirmDescription: Agents stop sending to Slack immediately, and the cached channel list is cleared so a new app re-reads it. Who is matched to which Slack account is kept, so reconnecting the same workspace does not ask you to match everyone again.

scopeGroups.hint: Broad means the whole workspace, not one channel. Open a group to see the details.
scopeGroups.withheldHint: Slack held this one back, so it is off.

channels.readingList: Reading the channel list from Slack.
channels.title: Channels {appName} can reach
channels.stalled: {appName} is not reading Slack right now. The list can be out of date.
channels.loadingList: Reading the channel list from Slack…
channels.emptyList: No channels yet. {appName} reads the list from Slack after it connects.
channels.copyFailed: Copying failed. Copy the command above by hand.
channels.addDescription: It is a private channel, so {appName} joins as you. Same as typing the invite yourself. Everyone in the channel sees it join. It reads nothing until you turn a permission on.
channels.askDescription: We cannot add {appName} to a private channel yet. Someone already in #{channel} has to run this.

people.title: Slack is connected
people.description: Match your CRM people to Slack once. Agents use these exact accounts later instead of guessing from a similar name.
people.stalled: {appName} is not reading Slack right now. These matches can be out of date.
people.noTeammates: No CRM teammates are available to match.
people.hint: Refresh after a Slack email changes. The CRM matches exact email addresses only. Someone with no exact match stays unmatched, and an agent stops instead of guessing at a similar name.
